verdict.rationale: Weave's marketing says it provides "powerful evaluation comparisons and visualizations to catch regressions" (docs-19). Its evaluation docs state the workflow lets you "compare changes over time, and identify regressions" (docs-31/38), and the GitHub README backs "apples-to-apples evaluations" (gh-4), with leaderboards aggregating evals (docs-23). Missing for 10: detailed docs on the side-by-side comparison view itself (per-example diffs, prompt/model version pairing) and independent or hands-on corroboration.
